required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh output of x's shape and dtype inside run().
One kernel pass over exactly n elements: load x and y, add in the native dtype (or a wider type cast back once), masked store.

forbidden_substitutions.message: A PyTorch add on the host (or in-place accumulation into an input) replaces the kernel.
The whole operator is performed by the PyTorch + operator on the input tensors.
Writing into or returning an input violates the fresh-output / no-mutation rules.
A dtype conversion; permitted only as a widen-then-cast-back that reproduces the native-dtype result (exact for int8).

required_evidence.message: No kernel-level store found; the add must be done by a kernel.
No bounds-handling evidence for a last partial block.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned tensor must be freshly allocated inside run() with x's shape and dtype and must not share storage with x or y

timing_boundary.notes: Everything inside run() is timed: the output allocation and the single elementwise kernel over n elements. No cached state, no copy or cast of the inputs, no second pass.
